summary_md: **Sympathy ([@SympathyLabs](https://x.com/SympathyLabs/status/2115098584979034420))** notes **dsh-local-ai 0.2.23**, which routes DeepSeek Harness calls to local Ollama or llama.cpp servers by task purpose or keyword before falling back to cloud APIs (Apache-2.0; fallback only triggers before the first token).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - PerryLink/dsh-local-ai: Local-model (Ollama) integration for DeepSeek Harness: discover, pull, remove, and inspect local models, route requests to them by task type or keyword with automatic fallback to the cloud, and get a one-shot status overview via /ollama.

relevance: Concrete local-first routing for a coding harness, with cloud fallback semantics spelled out.
